title: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5, and the export-control suspension
before: Export controls applied to chips, not to deployed models.
problem: A model whose capabilities are considered strategically sensitive raises questions no commercial framework had answered.
breakthrough: A Mythos-class model released above the Opus tier, then suspended three days later under a US Department of Commerce directive, and restored when the controls were lifted on 30 June.
why: The first documented case of a government forcing a deployed frontier model offline. The technical rationale has not been made public.
next: Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 in September, and an unsettled policy precedent.
inherits: Government intervention as a live factor in model deployment.
